metadata.title: chore(tests,lint): optimize slow tests and migrate pylint rules to ruff
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- **Test speed optimizations**: Mock real sleeps, subprocess delays, and crypto overhead across 10 slow tests, saving ~15s cumulative test time
- **Pylint-to-ruff migration**: Enable ruff PL rule family (98 rules), disable them in pylint, and fix all resulting violations

## Test Optimizations

| Test | Before | After | Fix |
|------|--------|-------|-----|
| gRPC `test_initialize_connection_error` | 3.02s | 0.09s | Mock `asyncio.sleep` in retry loop |
| `test_module_level_email_auth_*` | 1.83s | ~0.9s ea | Split dual module-reload |
| `test_module_level_reverse_proxy_*` | 1.80s | ~0.9s ea | Split dual module-reload |
| `test_runtime_logger_calls_*` | 1.73s | 1.44s | `"logger."` pre-filter on AST scan |
| e2e `test_server_startup_with_invalid_mappings` | 3.35s | ~0.8s | Reduce sleep 3s → 0.5s |
| `test_ttl_expiration` | 2.24s | ~0.01s | Monkeypatch `_now()` clock |
| `test_database_respond_message_check_loop` | 2.73s | ~0.03s | Mock `asyncio.sleep` in polling loop |
| `test_database_respond_ready_to_respond_logging` | 1.21s | ~0.03s | Same polling loop fix |
| `test_database_respond_message_remove_logging` | 1.21s | ~0.01s | Same polling loop fix |
| `test_expired_certificate_detection` | 1.27s | 0.03s | RSA 4096→2048 bit keys |

## Pylint → Ruff Migration

- Added `"PL"` to ruff select with `[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]` thresholds matching `.pylintrc`
- Disabled 98 migrated rules in both `.pylintrc` and `pyproject.toml [tool.pylint]`
- Auto-fixed: PLC0207 (maxsplit), PLR1711 (useless return), PLW1514 (encoding), PLR1714 (repeated equality)
- Added `noqa` for intentional violations: PLC2801 (dunder calls), PLR0917 (too many positional args), PLR0911 (too many returns)
- 255 pylint rules remain active (non-overlapping with ruff)

## Test plan
- [x] All modified tests pass individually
- [x] `test_main_extended.py` full suite passes (281 tests)
- [x] Certificate validation suite passes (8 tests)
- [x] Session registry tests pass (3 sibling tests)
- [x] Ruff passes clean
- [x] Pylint passes at 10.00/10

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
`split(":", maxsplit=1)` will break image refs that include a registry port (e.g., `registry:5000/ns/img:tag`) because it splits at the first `:` and treats `registry` as the “name.” Use a right-split for the tag removal (or a proper Docker image reference parser) so `base_image_name` is derived from the full ref without being corrupted by `host:port`.
```suggestion
    if ":" in image_tag:
        image_path, image_version = image_tag.rsplit(":", maxsplit=1)
    else:
        image_path, image_version = image_tag, "latest"
    base_image_name = image_path.split("/")[-1]  # Extract base name (e.g., "mcpgateway-gateway")
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: These tests previously waited to allow a background task/polling loop to run; now they assert immediately after `respond()`. If `respond()` schedules work on the event loop rather than awaiting it inline, this becomes flaky (asserting before the background processing runs). A robust approach is to signal completion via an `asyncio.Event` set inside `generate_response` (via `side_effect`) and `await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout=...)` before asserting; similarly for the caplog-based tests that rely on background logging.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: This mutates `fake_redis_client._now` without restoring it, which can leak state if the fixture/client is reused later in the test (or across tests, depending on fixture scope). Prefer `monkeypatch.setattr(fake_redis_client, "_now", ...)` so pytest will restore automatically, or restore `fake_redis_client._now = original_now` in a `finally` block.

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
`ast.parse(source)` drops the filename context, which makes syntax errors and diagnostics harder to interpret (they’ll reference `<unknown>`). Pass the filename for better tracebacks and debugging (e.g., `ast.parse(source, filename=str(file_path))`).
```suggestion
            tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(file_path))
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
A fixed 0.5s sleep can make this e2e test timing-sensitive on slower/loaded CI runners (process may not have exited yet). Instead of a single sleep, poll `process.poll()` in a short loop with a small sleep and an overall timeout (keeps it fast when the process exits quickly, but avoids flakes when it doesn’t).
```suggestion
            # Wait (with polling) to let process start and potentially exit on invalid args
            timeout = 5.0
            interval = 0.05
            loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
            start_time = loop.time()
            while process.poll() is None and (loop.time() - start_time) < timeout:
                await asyncio.sleep(interval)
```

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Good catch — fixed in b67b2df. Now uses `rsplit(":", maxsplit=1)` to extract the version first, so `registry:5000/ns/img:tag` is handled correctly.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: `respond()` awaits the polling loop inline — it does not schedule background work. The mocked `asyncio.sleep` lets the loop complete immediately, and assertions run after `respond()` returns, so there is no race. No change needed.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Agreed — fixed in b67b2df. Now uses `monkeypatch.setattr(fake_redis_client, "_now", ...)` for automatic cleanup.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Good suggestion — fixed in b67b2df. Now passes `filename=str(file_path)` to `ast.parse()`.

comments.author: jonpspri
comments.body: Agreed — fixed in b67b2df. Replaced the fixed sleep with a poll loop (50ms interval, 5s timeout) so it exits quickly when the process dies but remains robust on slow CI.

commits.message:
chore(tests,lint): optimize slow tests and migrate 98 pylint rules to ruff

Test optimizations:
- Mock asyncio.sleep in gRPC retry loop (3.02s → 0.09s)
- Split dual module-reload tests into single-reload pairs
- Add "logger." pre-filter to AST scan security test (1.73s → 1.44s)
- Reduce e2e translate sleep from 3s to 0.5s
- Monkeypatch InMemoryRedisClient._now() for TTL test (2.24s → 0.01s)
- Mock asyncio.sleep in database polling loop tests (1.21s → 0.03s each)
- Reduce RSA key size from 4096 to 2048 in cert tests (1.27s → 0.03s)

Pylint-to-ruff migration:
- Enable ruff PL rule family with thresholds matching pylint config
- Disable 98 migrated rules in both .pylintrc and pyproject.toml
- Auto-fix PLC0207, PLR1711, PLW1514, PLR1714 violations
- Add noqa comments for intentional PLC2801, PLR0917, PLR0911

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
